summary: Teads Holding Co. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026, subsidiary OT Midco Inc. and certain units entered a four-year $125.0 million non-recourse accounts receivable financing facility, with proceeds funding a portion of the A/R purchase price and general corporate purposes. The borrower SPVs (FF Cayman AR Ltd and FF Malta AR Ltd.) acquire receivables from Teads, Inc., Outbrain UK, Teads Limited, Teads France SAS, and Teads Italia S.r.l. under purchase and sale agreements, funded via secured loans from lenders with Sound Point Agency LLC as administrative and collateral agent. Borrowing availability is limited to a borrowing-base formula on eligible receivables. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation; watch receivable eligibility and servicing performance for covenant headroom.
